title: The Stamp Collectors’ Flight Day
description: On the collectors’ autumn holiday, stamps lift out of their albums. A mother and son watch an albatross leave its engraving and head for the open window.
alt: A woman and boy watch an albatross emerge from a floating postage stamp. Two smaller stamps sail through an open window over an autumn town.
pairing: An autumn stamp collectors’ holiday × birds that fly out of their postage stamps
